name: Crypto Market
author: Simon Schubert
description: CoinGecko as an app: the top 100 to 1,000 coins with 7-day sparklines, coin pages with price charts, market cap, supply and all-time highs, a watchlist, trending coins, gainers and losers, categories, a converter and a portfolio with profit and loss. Fetches market data from CoinGecko over HTTPS. Laid out for the desktop and the phone.
